taxpayer_name.rationale: Taxpayer name is a header field not represented as a leaf element in the Schedule D XSD candidate list.

ssn.rationale: SSN is a header field not represented as a leaf element in the Schedule D XSD candidate list.

tax_year.rationale: Tax year is metadata not represented as a leaf element in the Schedule D XSD candidate list.

line_1a_proceeds.rationale: TotalSTCGL1099BBssRptNoAdjGrp/TotalProceedsSalesPriceAmt matches Line 1a short-term basis-reported no-adjustment proceeds.

line_1a_cost.rationale: TotalSTCGL1099BBssRptNoAdjGrp/TotalCostOrOtherBasisAmt matches Line 1a short-term basis-reported no-adjustment cost.

line_1a_adjustments.rationale: The 1a group (TotalSTCGL1099BBssRptNoAdjGrp) has no adjustments element by design — no adjustments apply to these transactions.

line_1a_gain_loss.rationale: TotalSTCGL1099BBssRptNoAdjGrp/TotalGainOrLossAmt matches Line 1a net gain or loss.

line_1b_proceeds.rationale: TotalSTCGL1099BShowsBasisGrp/TotalProceedsSalesPriceAmt matches Line 1b (Box A/G) short-term with basis shown proceeds.

line_1b_gain_loss.rationale: TotalSTCGL1099BShowsBasisGrp/TotalGainOrLossAmt matches Line 1b net gain or loss.

line_1c_proceeds.rationale: TotalSTCGL1099BNotShowBasisGrp/TotalProceedsSalesPriceAmt matches Line 1c (Box B/H) short-term without basis shown proceeds.

line_1c_gain_loss.rationale: TotalSTCGL1099BNotShowBasisGrp/TotalGainOrLossAmt matches Line 1c net gain or loss.

line_2_proceeds.rationale: TotalSTCGL1099BNotReceivedGrp/TotalProceedsSalesPriceAmt matches Line 2 (Box C/I) short-term not reported to IRS proceeds; blueprint labels this line 2 but the form labels it line 3 — the blueprint description aligns with Box C/I.

line_2_gain_loss.rationale: TotalSTCGL1099BNotReceivedGrp/TotalGainOrLossAmt matches Line 2 net gain or loss (Box C/I).

line_3_gain_loss.rationale: NetSTGainOrLossFromSchK1Amt matches Line 3 short-term gain or loss from Schedule K-1.

line_4_gain_loss.rationale: STGainOrLossFromFormsAmt is the closest match for Line 4 short-term gain/loss from Form 8824 and other short-term forms.

line_5_loss_carryover.rationale: STCapitalLossCarryoverAmt matches Line 5 short-term capital loss carryover.

line_6_net_short_term.rationale: NetSTCapitalGainOrLossAmt matches Line 6 net short-term capital gain or loss.

line_8a_proceeds.rationale: TotalLTCGL1099BBssRptNoAdjGrp/TotalProceedsSalesPriceAmt matches Line 8a long-term basis-reported no-adjustment proceeds.

line_8a_adjustments.rationale: The 8a group (TotalLTCGL1099BBssRptNoAdjGrp) has no adjustments element by design — no adjustments apply to these transactions.

line_8a_gain_loss.rationale: TotalLTCGL1099BBssRptNoAdjGrp/TotalGainOrLossAmt matches Line 8a net gain or loss.

line_8b_proceeds.rationale: TotalLTCGL1099BShowsBasisGrp/TotalProceedsSalesPriceAmt matches Line 8b (Box D/J) long-term with basis shown proceeds.

line_8b_gain_loss.rationale: TotalLTCGL1099BShowsBasisGrp/TotalGainOrLossAmt matches Line 8b net gain or loss.

line_8c_proceeds.rationale: TotalLTCGL1099BNotShowBasisGrp/TotalProceedsSalesPriceAmt matches Line 8c (Box E/K) long-term without basis shown proceeds.

line_8c_gain_loss.rationale: TotalLTCGL1099BNotShowBasisGrp/TotalGainOrLossAmt matches Line 8c net gain or loss.

line_9_proceeds.rationale: TotalLTCGL1099BNotReceivedGrp/TotalProceedsSalesPriceAmt matches Line 9 (Box F/L) long-term not reported to IRS proceeds.

line_9_gain_loss.rationale: TotalLTCGL1099BNotReceivedGrp/TotalGainOrLossAmt matches Line 9 net gain or loss.

line_10_gain_loss.rationale: NetLTGainOrLossFromSchK1Amt matches Line 10 long-term gain or loss from Schedule K-1.

line_11_gain_loss.rationale: LTGainOrLossFromFormsAmt is the closest match for Line 11 long-term gain from Form 4797 and other long-term forms.

line_12_gain_distributions.rationale: CapitalGainDistributionsAmt matches Line 12 capital gain distributions.

line_13_loss_carryover.rationale: LTCapitalLossCarryoverAmt matches Line 13 long-term capital loss carryover.

line_14_net_long_term.rationale: NetLTCapitalGainOrLossAmt matches Line 14 net long-term capital gain or loss.

line_15_combined.rationale: NetSTAndLTCapitalGainOrLossAmt matches Line 15 combined net capital gain or loss.

line_16_net_capital_gain.rationale: No distinct candidate for Line 16 net capital gain exists; ZeroOrBlankInd and STAndLTGainInd are indicators, not amount fields — no amount element maps cleanly to Line 16.

line_17_capital_loss_deduction.rationale: AllowableLossAmt matches Line 17 allowable capital loss deduction.

line_18_28_percent_rate_gain.rationale: RateGainWrkshtAmt matches Line 18 28% rate gain from the Rate Gain Worksheet.

line_19_unrecaptured_sec1250_gain.rationale: UnrcptrSect1250GainWrkshtAmt matches Line 19 unrecaptured Section 1250 gain.

line_20_both_gains.rationale: STAndLTGainInd is the best available indicator for the Line 20 yes/no checkbox about both lines 14 and 15 being gains.

line_21_loss_limit.rationale: No separate candidate for Line 21 loss limit amount exists; AllowableLossAmt (idx 0) was already matched to Line 17, and no second amount element corresponds to Line 21's carryover worksheet reference.

line_22_qualified_dividends_worksheet.rationale: QualifiedDividendsInd matches Line 22 checkbox indicating whether the taxpayer must complete the Qualified Dividends and Capital Gain Tax Worksheet.
